answer_1.quote: we introduce Negative Implicit Feedback from Smart Reply ("NIFTY"). NIFTY employs classifier guidance to controllably integrate one-shot implicit negative feedback into the generation process at run-time.

answer_2.quote: We employ both automatic and human evaluation. ROUGE-L, which has been used previously in AI writing tasks, measures the longest common subsequence within the prediction, capturing surface-level overlap with the ground-truth. ... we complement this metric with R@1, which measures the proportion of generated responses that contain the correct intent.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk. ... For each model and dataset, we randomly select 100 data points from the test set and assign 3 annotators to each data point.
answer_4.guideline: You will be shown a target reply and two candidate replies. Select which candidate reply is most similar to the target reply. Similar means having the same semantic meaning.
